mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns relative to historical averages.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated CPIAUCSL above 330.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that increase equity discount rates and produce negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 330.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 330.0) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) signals delayed monetary tightening, increasing real interest rate uncertainty and producing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 330.0 and FEDFUNDS < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 24000) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 1500) signal robust economic momentum, driving positive equity returns through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances during late-cycle expansions with GDPC1 > 24000 and HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profit growth and producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, labor market tightness boosts consumer spending and corporate margins, producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS > 750000) and payrolls (PAYEMS > 158000) signals robust consumer demand and labor market strength, driving positive equity returns through elevated corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS > 750000 and PAYEMS > 158000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 105.0, it signals economic overheating and potential central bank intervention, producing negative S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0.
